tagline: What should change in the next sample?

current_sample.target_definition: CHEST_CASE: increase measured garment bust by 3 cm

hypotheses.text: Chest tightness is insufficient garment bust ease, not a shoulder lock.
hypotheses.support: shirt.width.v maps 1:1 onto measured bust; chest clearance p10 rises from 0.47 to 0.50 cm at +3 cm.

hypotheses.text: Waist will track the bust edit on this untapered Shirt (flare=1.0).
hypotheses.support: Atomic calibration G4 PARTIAL: waist_delta equals bust_delta.

hypotheses.text: Sleeve.length.v was previously mis-measured on panel Y; panel X is the construction axis.
hypotheses.support: sleeves.py places length along X; connecting_width is the shoulder-region candidate, not body shoulder_w.

candidates.note: Shirt program has no independent garment shoulder_w. Probe connecting_width in hero pipeline.
Re-measured on sleeve panel X in the completion pipeline.

recommendation.summary: Bust +3 cm via shirt.width.v. Hits the CHEST_CASE target. Expect waist to follow 1:1.
recommendation.why_not_plus2: Leaves 1 cm target error. Utility ranking prefers +3 even after the 0.15*|edit| penalty.

hero_cases.title: Chest too tight → Bust +3 cm
hero_cases.problem: Sample reads tight across the chest on mean_all. Target is baseline bust + 3 cm.
hero_cases.evidence: Pattern realized_delta = 3.000 cm. Chest clearance p10 0.47 → 0.50 cm. Contact ratio 0.027 → 0.022.

hero_cases.title: Same measurements, different cloth bending
hero_cases.problem: Identical 2D specs; default vs mid_bending materials. Measurement-only cannot split them.
hero_cases.evidence: Hero physics pair (tight_default vs tight_stiff) is the disambiguation test.

hero_cases.title: Bust edit drags waist
hero_cases.problem: flare=1 Shirt: waist_delta tracks bust_delta. A smaller edit can be preferred if waist risk is priced in.
hero_cases.evidence: G4 PARTIAL locality. Utility uses 0.5*(|sleeve|+|length|) but waist coupling is structural.

hero_cases.title: OOD body → abstain / escalate
hero_cases.problem: mean_female / mean_male held out of a mean_all-trained selector.
hero_cases.best: abstain if body not in support

hero_cases.title: Shoulder vs bust competition
hero_cases.problem: No calibrated garment shoulder map on this Shirt. Do not recommend a fake shoulder +1.
hero_cases.best: bust family only; shoulder NO-GO unless connecting_width probe GO
hero_cases.evidence: shoulder_plus_1cm remains NOT_VERIFIED on the CHEST_CASE lattice.
